text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Satsuki Sho has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon says the data from this race will be an important indicator for the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having thoroughly prepared for the occasion, she marches forward to take on the first of the Triple Crown tour.
